name: SPELL-GIFT-arms-a-free-ready
why: allyNear asks allyMarksFor, which answers no mate for a free ready (readiedFree is set a line above) or for a spell that is no gift - so the guard in front of it repeats that law rather than making it. Recorded because the guard reads like the only thing keeping a trap's payload from arming, and the next reader should know allyMarksFor is.
